name: Benchmark
concept: The plain v16 fighter: a 20-card clash deck and a 10-card neutral deck. Jab starts combos; Big Swing ends them with a cash, Sweep with a knockdown. Throw stands alone. 8 Counters. Neutral: Focus, Armor, Mix-Up, Parry: a threat for each type.

cards.name: Focus
cards.flavour: Reset and breathe: a card and a bar of meter.

cards.name: Armor
cards.flavour: Brace through their poke: the heavy swing absorbs it.

cards.name: Mix-Up
cards.flavour: High or low? Their guard guesses wrong.

cards.name: Parry
cards.flavour: Read the strike, turn it aside, and open them up.

super.name: Overdrive
super.flavour: Ends a combo with a cash and a knockdown.
